title: DroneMissionPlan
description: Structured, executor-facing representation of an operator command for a MAVSDK/PX4 drone. The LLM must emit ONLY an object matching this schema. Nothing outside this schema is trusted.

mission_type.description: patrol = repeat a closed shape N times; route = one-shot list of waypoints; go_to_point = single destination

pattern.description: How to generate the horizontal geometry. 'waypoints' means use the explicit waypoints list.

speed_mps.description: Horizontal cruise speed. Hard-capped by the validator regardless of LLM proposal.

altitude_m.description: Constant relative altitude (AGL) the whole mission flies at.

waypoints.description: Explicit [north_m, east_m] points relative to the takeoff point (local NED), used when pattern == 'waypoints'.

notes.description: Free-text LLM rationale, never executed, only logged.
